# 72° AI LABS

> Bespoke AI systems for growing businesses. Built in India.

72° AI LABS designs and builds custom AI systems on your actual business data — not generic demos. We work with SMEs and mid-sized enterprises in India to turn scattered data across finance, operations, documents, and workflows into working intelligence.

## About

- **Company**: 72° AI LABS
- **Website**: https://72ai.in
- **Location**: India
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Founder**: Mandar Gite (BITS Pilani alumnus)
- **Tagline**: Frugal AI built for SMEs

The name "72°" comes from the external angle of a regular pentagon — a shape that encodes the golden ratio. We read a few observable signals to decode the structure underneath a business, so decisions become obvious.

## What We Do

We build bespoke AI systems across six practice areas:

**Finance Automation**
Automated ledger reconciliation, intelligent financial data processing, and clean accounting pipelines for Indian businesses. Key project: FastAccounting.

**Operational Intelligence**
Real-time insights and workflow automation for F&B, manufacturing, and service operations. Projects include: CallMind (AI call intelligence), Cascade (operational dashboards), Hospitality Hub, Tire Analytics.

**Document & OCR Systems**
Advanced document understanding, OCR, and intelligent data extraction from complex formats (PDFs, invoices, handwritten records). Projects: DocIntel, JNV Essays.

**On-Premises LLM Systems**
Privacy-first, local LLM deployments for sensitive data and air-gapped environments. No data leaves your infrastructure. Project: InsightBridge.

**Content & Marketing Intelligence**
AI-powered content generation and marketing analytics on local, privacy-first infrastructure. Project: MarTech Suite.

**Data Engineering & Integration**
Robust data pipelines, feature engineering, time-series modeling, and forecasting for complex datasets. Projects: NextSurge (equity forecasting), Used Car pricing model.

## How We Work

- We build on your actual data, not generic models
- Frugal architecture: no unnecessary infrastructure bloat
- Context-aware systems that fit how your business already operates
- Python-based stack: RAG pipelines, fine-tuned models, workflow automation
- Deployable on-prem or cloud

## Who We Work With

- SMEs and mid-sized enterprises in India
- Industries: F&B, Manufacturing, Finance, Retail, Logistics
- Companies moving beyond spreadsheets to structured intelligence

## Blog Posts

**I Ran Karpathy's AutoResearch on a $300 GPU**
https://72ai.in/blog/autoresearch_2026-04-14
57 autonomous AI experiments on an RTX 3060 overnight. The agent discovered that on consumer hardware, smaller models and more iterations beat larger models — inverting the standard ML scaling playbook. 23.4% improvement in prediction quality, 66% smaller model, 55% less VRAM.

**Building Multi-Agent AI Systems That Actually Work**
https://72ai.in/blog/blog1_martech_technical
Architecture deep dive into a production multi-agent RAG system with four specialized agents (planner, researcher, writer, reviewer), iterative quality loops, graceful degradation, and real-time streaming. Runs entirely on local hardware.

**Welcome to 72° AI Labs Blog**
https://72ai.in/blog/welcome-to-72ai-blog
Introduction to our blog covering practical AI implementation, real-world case studies, and operational intelligence for Indian SMBs. Every post prioritizes clear ROI metrics, real code, and honest trade-offs.
